public.title: 1 · Public (anonymous)
public.cond: Ladder base. TWO TREES ONLY: pages live in the public tree — the URL names the view, identity gates the actions; only owner and admin keep their own trees. ONE GOLD ACTION per page; every empty state says what happens next. Guests via /l/:code see the SAME pages (scoped). Auth walls → /signin. FOOTER everywhere: beta notice + "GDPR concerns → support@uadebate.com".

participant.title: 3 · Participant (registered speaker)
participant.cond: All public pages (+ user pages when signed in) + own signup on the session page, their room row tinted + jump chip. Session-scoped identity, not a club role: a guest via /l/:code rides on public, an account rides on user — same pages.

judge.title: 3 · Judge (chairs a room)
judge.cond: All participant pages + the room panel at the same room URL: allocator, set/publish motion, fill ballot. Powers come from the CHAIR of a room; judge before rooms exist = spectator.

member.title: 4 · Member
member.cond: All user pages + participant/judge by registering + the club roster (/c/:club/members) and being on it; the club appears in the cabinet. Member of several clubs — fine.

owner.title: 5 · Owner (club head)
owner.cond: All member pages (and every room's judge powers) + the owner tree. FULL CONTROL: set/publish motions, fill/edit/confirm ballots on EVERY room — editing a confirmed ballot is one "edit ballot" action (lock handling is internal, never a page verb). Lifecycle: Start session → Reopen registration | Finish session.

admin.title: 6 · Admin (platform)
admin.cond: Every club's owner tree + all below + /admin: club creation, user ops. is_admin, 404 for everyone else.

phoenix-api.title: 7 · Phoenix API — /api/v1 (cab)
phoenix-api.cond: Every page verb above is one of these REST calls — same ClubScope ladder enforces role coverage. CACHE: a finished session is immutable — cached hard, forever; the live session page is no-store. Session cookie today; keyed public API = pillar 3. Green = the engine call behind the write.

engine-api.title: 8 · Engine API — node :3100 (internal only)
engine-api.cond: Everything cab persists lives here; only cab calls it. cab stores engine_round_id at session creation and fans the 4 state reads out concurrently — one state read per request. Auth: HS256 JWT {id, isAdmin} minted per request by cab. Guards: admin · org = owner/organiser · chair = room judge (falls through to org). Never public.

user.title: 2 · User (signed in)
user.cond: All public pages + an identity: cabinet (home), My page, /account, join requests, prefilled registration. No club ties needed — a user with zero memberships still has all of this.
